vouches_for: only that, at observed_at, an unpaid request to url returned a 402 naming this amount, asset, network and payTo
how_to_buy: Call the url yourself and pay per the 402 it returns. This hub is not in the payment path and holds no seller signature: refuse if that 402 names another payTo than pay_to here, or asks for more than amount_atomic.

routes.description: Translate text to Spanish as spoken in Argentina and Uruguay (rioplatense, voseo): up to 6,000 characters from any language, keeping names, numbers, links and formatting. Use this when an agent needs Spanish copy for Argentine or Uruguayan users, such as support replies, product listings, notifications or marketing, instead of neutral or European Spanish. Optional tone: formal, neutral or casual. JSON output. Free sample at /api/translate-es/sample.

Calculate exact incoming, outgoing, net and self-transfer USDC amounts for one wallet from a supplied Base transaction receipt. Returns individual Transfer events and rejects malformed or duplicate USDC events. No live RPC lookup: receipt authenticity, chain membership and finality are not independently verified. Net flow is not a wallet balance or proof of revenue.

Consulta una página de variables u observaciones por fecha de la API pública de estadísticas v4.0 del BCRA. El filtro de texto se aplica solo a la página recibida. La serie admite un identificador de variable y fechas opcionales. Incluye URL de fuente, hora de lectura y paginación informada por BCRA. Hace una lectura sin reintentos y rechaza respuestas incompletas. No ofrece búsqueda global ni historiales completos.

Drafts a firm, courteous formal letter in Argentine Spanish using the supplied information. Supports reclamo, intimacion or solicitud and an optional requested response period. Does not verify facts or determine legal effects. If drafting fails, returns the existing template and explains its scope. Examples preserve the supplied Spanish text.

Compare two strings literally without normalization or inference. Returns equality, lengths and the first difference with Unicode code point and UTF-16 positions. Each input supports up to 20000 UTF-16 units. Does not verify file bytes, facts or delivery acceptance.

Consulta precio spot USD, capitalización y variación porcentual de 24 horas para 1 a 20 IDs de CoinGecko. Incluye fuente y hora de lectura; actualización del proveedor cuando existe. Las métricas opcionales ausentes son null; un precio ausente produce error. Una lectura por ejecución, sin reintentos automáticos. La fuente puede usar caché; sus fallos y HTTP 429 generan errores claros.

Validate an Argentine CUIT or CUIL tax id: format and check-digit verification, normalized and formatted forms, declared type (CUIT or CUIL). Use this when an agent collects Argentine customer or supplier ids and must reject typos before invoicing, KYC or onboarding. Mathematical validation only: it does not confirm registration or ownership. JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/cuit-ar/sample.

Hash sha256, sha512, sha1 or md5, HMAC, JWT decode (header, payload, expiry, optional HS256 check), UUID v4, base64 encode and decode, URL parse, time zone convert and unix to ISO: one deterministic op per call. Use this when an agent needs a verifiable transform without shipping its own library. Pure Node, no upstream, no model inference, nothing stored, JSON out. Free sample at /api/dev-utils/sample.

Returns possible Argentine address matches from Georef, preserving source records, URL and reading time. An optional province identifier restricts the request; records outside that province cause rejection. Results do not guarantee a unique or correct match or an exhaustive search.

Return official, blue, MEP (bolsa) and CCL rates published by DolarAPI, with buy and sell prices, source URL, reading time, source update timestamps and evidence references. Does not guarantee real-time prices or independent confirmation.

FX rates and currency conversion reference: daily exchange rates for up to 20 currencies against one base (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, BRL, MXN, ARS and about 160 more) with rate, reference date and source URL from Frankfurter (central-bank data, MIT licence). Use this when an agent needs an official-style exchange rate to price, invoice or convert amounts and must cite where it came from. Daily rates, not intraday; JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/fx-rates/sample.

Receive a base64-encoded ZIP containing a Node.js lead workflow with Facebook webhook verification, HubSpot and Slack adapters, persistent recovery, tests and deployment instructions. Requires configuration and hosting. Live provider delivery has not been verified.

Argentina official gazette (Boletin Oficial) keyword search returning literal excerpts of matching notices with dates and source URLs; an optional date limits the search to that day's notices. Use this when an agent needs primary-source evidence of an Argentine regulation, decree, resolution or notice. No completeness guarantee and no legal interpretation; if the official search cannot be verified the call fails and is not settled. Free sample at /api/normativa-ar/sample.

Consulta una página de mercados públicos de Gamma o posiciones y actividad de una billetera en Data API. Los filtros y el orden de mercados se aplican solo a la página recibida. Devuelve campos originales compactos, fuente y hora de lectura. No acredita coincidencias globales, rankings ni cobertura completa de la billetera. Si la fuente falla, devuelve un error sin inventar resultados.

Summarize text with evidence: send 1 to 4,000 characters in English or Spanish and get a short summary plus 1 to 3 supporting quotes verified as exact substrings of your text, with a limitations note. Use this when an agent must condense an article, email or document and needs citations it can check before putting them in a report. Works only on the supplied text, no web retrieval, JSON out. Free sample at /api/source-bounded-summary/sample.

Extrae contenido legible y título de una página HTML pública HTTPS, como texto o Markdown simple. Una lectura sin reintentos. Elimina scripts, estilos y navegación reconocida mediante reglas heurísticas. No ejecuta JavaScript ni accede a páginas con login. El lector limita el contenido a 20.000 caracteres y se informa el recorte. La extracción del contenido principal es aproximada.

Web page to Markdown for LLMs: give a public HTTPS URL and get its main content as clean Markdown (format=markdown) or plain text, with title, character count and truncation flags; scripts, styles, navigation and ads are stripped. Use it when an agent needs to read one page for research, RAG, monitoring or summarization without a browser or API key. Also plain text, Markdown, JSON and RSS. No JavaScript rendering or login pages; up to 20,000 characters. Free sample at /api/web-read/sample.

Analyze redacted webhook JSONL for repeated received or success records and event IDs with both failure and success records. Deterministic JSON; no inference. Maximum 10000 UTF-16 code units of JSONL, 20000 UTF-8 bytes for the complete JSON request, 500 nonblank records and 1000 physical lines. Use one provider and environment per request. Counts do not prove duplicate business effects or safe retries. Reports retain event IDs; remove secrets and personal data before submitting.

Match receipt claims to individual Base USDC Transfer logs in RPC records you supply. Returns unmatched or ambiguous claims, duplicate event counts and declared-wallet exclusions. No live RPC verification or purchase attribution. Send a JSON-string bundle containing tape and evidence. Historical Bazaar snapshots remain available with operation=market_stats.

x402 payment test and ping: one call with no required parameters returns server time (ISO 8601 and Unix ms), a request id, the seller payTo, chain id and an echo of your optional text, only after a real settlement. Use this when an agent needs to prove its payment flow works, measure round-trip latency or run a cheap scheduled canary against a live seller. No upstream, no model inference; paid round trip 1 to 2 s. Free sample at /api/x402-ping/sample.

Your conditions, one fetch: status, substring, JSON value — signed pass/fail receipt. Default status 200. Public proof: check_url_sealed. Watch: check_url_changes. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402
Export a portable PriorSeal receipt bundle
Verify x402 payment and signed delivery compatibility; this does not inspect your Agent target
Issue a signed readiness report for the public EVM address your Agent will actually integrate; chainId and a non-zero subjectAddress are required
Purchase 100 PriorSeal Agent Credits for an existing authenticated Agent account

Pre-trade decision-input integrity check: is the price this action relies on trustworthy? Cross-provider consensus, deviation, freshness, and manipulation risk for one trade, with verifiable EIP-712 attestation support. BLOCK verdicts are complete checks and are charged.

Monad Lending Guard: a read-only, pre-signing decision for direct Aave V3 Monad calls or exact Morpho Blue Monad markets. GET returns a preview; POST binds one unsigned direct call and may return an Insight EIP-712 decision attestation. It never authorizes or broadcasts a transaction.
routes.detail: the 402 asks for an asset this hub cannot price in USD

routes.description: HyperEVM Lending Guard: a read-only, pre-signing decision for direct HyperLend Core (Aave V3 fork) supply or borrow on HyperEVM chain 999 with reviewed WHYPE, WSTHYPE, UBTC, UETH, USDe, sUSDe, USDT0, KHYPE, and USDC markets. GET returns a preview; POST binds one unsigned direct call and may return an Insight EIP-712 decision attestation. It never authorizes or broadcasts a transaction.
routes.detail: the 402 asks for an asset this hub cannot price in USD

routes.description: Monad Perp Guard: a read-only, pre-trade decision gate for opening a Perpl AUSD-margined perpetual position on Monad mainnet (reviewed BTC, MON, ETH, and SOL markets). It evaluates the underlying cross-oracle consensus integrity on canonical mainnet feeds, binds the declared leverage to a reviewed static profile capped by the live Perpl initial-margin ratio, and attaches disclosed venue evidence (Perpl mark/oracle divergence, funding rate, open interest, market status, consensus-vs-oracle deviation; the AUSD margin peg is disclosed as not independently verified). It never signs, submits, or authorizes an order.
routes.detail: the 402 asks for an asset this hub cannot price in USD

routes.description: MCP tools/call over JSON-RPC (streamable HTTP): pay-per-call access to the Insight MCP catalog for x402 agents without an API key. The catalog exposes 20 discoverable names: the product tools trade_guard, trade_proof, oracle_watch_window and position_lifecycle, plus 16 deprecated alias spellings callable at the same price until 2027-01-06. trade_guard's check_safety op returns a PASS, CAUTION, DANGER or BLOCK verdict with reasons; prepare_swap and prepare_perp_order return an unsigned exchange payload. MCP prices are $0.040 per trade_guard or trade_proof call, $0.500 per oracle_watch_window and $0.550 per position_lifecycle. The shelf amount below is $0.040 (40000 atomic units), the trade_guard safety-op price that Bazaar indexes; the live 402 quote is authoritative and prices each call from its tool metering class (C1=2000, C2=4000, C3=20000, C4=40000 atomic). The C3 $0.02 price is the REST /api/v1/safety/pre-trade route, not the MCP trade_guard safety-op price.
Execution preflight: a chain-neutral ALLOW/CAUTION/BLOCK data-sufficiency decision for one declared action. A complete BLOCK result is charged; settlement occurs only after a successful response.

Base Lending Guard: a read-only, pre-signing decision for Aave V3, exact Morpho Blue markets, Compound V3 Base USDC Comet, or reviewed Moonwell Base markets. GET returns a preview; POST accepts one unsigned direct call and may return an Insight EIP-712 decision attestation. It never authorizes or broadcasts a transaction.

Base Perp Guard: a read-only, pre-trade decision-input integrity gate for opening a Synthetix Perps V3 position on Base (reviewed BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, and PEPE markets, USDC margin). It separately evaluates the underlying and USDC margin oracle integrity and checks caller-declared post-action leverage against reviewed market caps. GET returns a preview; POST accepts one unsigned direct PerpsMarketProxy commitOrder call and may return an Insight EIP-712 decision attestation. It never signs, broadcasts, or authorizes an order.

Hyperliquid Perp Guard: a read-only, pre-trade decision-input integrity gate for one declared Hyperliquid HyperCore order intent (asset index, size, leverage, price). It evaluates underlying oracle integrity and the declared leverage against Hyperliquid margin requirements, and POST binds the exact unsigned exchange envelope — including intent hash, asset index, size, price, and expiry — into an Insight EIP-712 decision attestation. It never signs, submits, or authorizes an order.

BNB Perp Guard: a read-only, pre-trade decision gate for opening an Aster Perps USDT-margined perpetual position on BNB Smart Chain (reviewed BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT markets). It separately evaluates the underlying and USDT margin cross-oracle consensus integrity on canonical mainnet feeds, binds the declared leverage to a reviewed static profile capped by the live Aster required-margin ratio, and attaches disclosed venue evidence (Aster mark/index divergence, funding rate, open interest, market status, consensus-vs-index deviation). It never signs, submits, or authorizes an order.

Prediction Guard: a read-only screening gate for one Polymarket market entry. Cross-oracle consensus is deliberately not applied to event markets; the guard verifies machine-parseable price-contract metadata, lifecycle and resolution timing, quoted-probability integrity, and whether the declared settlement venue can be verified post-hoc by the settlement-evidence pipeline. It never signs, submits, or authorizes an order.

Solana Lending Guard: a read-only, pre-signing decision for one direct Kamino Lend, Marginfi v2, Jupiter Lend Earn deposit, or Save Lend reserve-liquidity deposit instruction. POST verifies program-owned accounts and simulates the exact unsigned Solana message before optionally returning an Insight Ed25519 decision attestation. It never authorizes or broadcasts a transaction.

Solana Perp Guard: a read-only, pre-trade decision gate for opening a Drift Protocol v2 perpetual position on Solana mainnet (reviewed SOL, BTC, and ETH markets, USDC margin). It evaluates underlying and USDC cross-oracle consensus integrity on canonical mainnet feeds, checks caller-declared post-action leverage against a reviewed static profile capped by the live Drift margin ratio, and attaches disclosed on-chain venue evidence (Drift mark price vs Pyth Lazer oracle deviation, funding rate, open interest, market status). It never signs, submits, or authorizes an order.

Solana Swap Guard: a read-only, pre-signing decision for exactly one unsigned Orca Whirlpool USDC/USDT 0.01% swap on Solana mainnet (both directions). POST canonical-decodes the single Whirlpool swap instruction, re-verifies the pool, vaults, tick array, oracle, and both user token accounts from live mainnet state, prices the pool from its own sqrtPrice against independent oracle consensus, and simulates the exact unsigned message before optionally returning an Insight Ed25519 decision attestation bound to the message hash. CAUTION or BLOCK returns no executable payload. It never authorizes or broadcasts a transaction.

Loopscale Vault Deposit Guard: a read-only, pre-signing preparation for one official Loopscale Solana lending-vault deposit. POST validates live vault metadata and principal mint, accepts only a single returned message with no preliminary transactions, resolves address lookup tables, simulates the exact unsigned message, and may return an Insight Ed25519 decision attestation. It never authorizes or broadcasts a transaction.

Settlement Evidence Grade (legacy): an on-demand, idempotent historical record of one settled Polymarket price contract. POST takes a market slug only; the declared outcome is always read from the Insight watch list, never from the caller. Returns a signed EIP-712 evidence pack carrying derived analytics: declared versus independently observed outcome, bps deltas, and coverage statistics. The grade describes a market that has already resolved. It is NOT a safety assessment, NOT a recommendation, and NOT a verdict about any live configuration. Retained for existing integrations. For a signed, advisory, independently recomputable record of an oracle configuration and its source state, use POST /api/v1/oracle-config/snapshot instead. Existing packs are returned cached and are never downgraded.

Oracle Config Snapshot (signed record): an advisory, idempotent EIP-712 record of one oracle configuration and its independent-source state at a point in time. The request names chainId, protocolId and assetSymbol only; all observable configuration and sources are read server-side. This is NOT a safety assessment and makes no safe or unsafe claim. Derived analytics only, no custody, no execution authority.
Verified Swap Intent: two signed schema-v3 Pre-Trade gates for one same-chain swap, plus one Execution Receipt credit after x402 settlement. A BLOCK is a complete, charged decision.

Oracle Watch Monitored Window (24h): one settlement pre-pays continuous Oracle Watch halt/proceed signal coverage for one (symbol, chain) position for 24 hours. The purchase returns a one-time window token; in-window signal polls are token-authenticated and never charged per call. Assessment and evidence only — no custody, no execution authority.

Position Lifecycle Bundle (24h): one settlement pre-pays a full monitored lifecycle for one (symbol, chain) position — an embedded Oracle Watch window (48 free signal polls), 4 bundled guard assessments across any position-guard family, and 1 attested execution receipt. The purchase returns a one-time lifecycle token; bundled calls are token-authenticated and never charged per call. Assessment and evidence only — no custody, no execution authority.
